intro: Today's coverage highlights Armenia's constitutional reform debate, the issue of Armenian hostages in Azerbaijan, diplomatic engagements with India and regional bodies, sports achievements at world championships, and economic developments including energy talks and a major crypto hack.

topics.title: Constitutional reform debate intensifies in Armenia
topics.text: The ruling party has asked the opposition to support a constitutional referendum, while the Justice Ministry seeks to discipline a judge who recused himself from the Catholicos trial. Parliament's speaker urged the opposition to let voters decide on a new constitution, and CivilNet published an explainer on the votes needed for adoption.

topics.title: ANC-International publishes dossier on Armenian hostages held by Azerbaijan
topics.text: ANC-International has released a dossier detailing 20 Armenian hostages being held by Azerbaijan. The publication has been covered by multiple Armenian news outlets, highlighting the ongoing humanitarian concern.

topics.title: Armenia and India hold political consultations in New Delhi
topics.text: Armenia and India conducted their 12th round of political consultations in New Delhi, discussing development prospects for bilateral relations. The meetings included engagement with Indian industry and investment organizations.

topics.title: Armenian athletes win medals at World Championships
topics.text: Wrestler Vazgen Tevanyan won a silver medal at the World Wrestling Championships, while weightlifter Alexandra Grigoryan secured a bronze medal at the World Weightlifting Championships, marking Armenia's first medal at the 2026 event. Greco-Roman wrestlers also claimed gold and bronze medals.

topics.title: Regional energy and transport corridor discussions advance
topics.text: Armenia is considering purchasing gas from Azerbaijan alongside supplies from Russia and Iran. Azerbaijan's Foreign Minister stated that the Middle and Zangezur Corridors will increase the country's opportunities, while Turkish business leaders are pressing for trade with Armenia as Ankara sets conditions.

topics.title: Binance suffers $6.3 billion crypto hack
topics.text: Hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance in what is being described as the world's largest crypto heist. The exchange says it is beginning to recover the stolen funds. The incident was reported by multiple financial and technology news sources.

topics.title: Armenian officials engage in regional and international diplomacy
topics.text: Foreign Minister Ararat Mirzoyan will attend the Manama Dialogue security forum in Bahrain. National Assembly Speaker Alen Simonyan will attend a CIS Security Council Secretaries meeting in Russia, as will Armenia's Security Council chief. Armenia and the EU discussed progress in the visa liberalization process.
